accepts the configuration, then restart on it. On failure the running version stays: `failed`.

again with the same command line — applying the configuration written since. Never automatic.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: What the agent is doing, the first that holds in this order.

AgentActivityOut.title: AgentActivityOut
AgentActivityOut.description:
What the agent is doing now, from what really runs: `GET /agent/activity`, and `event: activity` on
the journal's stream at its start and on every change.

AgentOut.title: AgentOut
AgentOut.description: The assistant itself, as the front's sidebar shows it.

AttachmentKind.title: AttachmentKind
AttachmentKind.description: What a file sent along a message is, as the person meant it.

AttachmentOut.title: AttachmentOut
AttachmentOut.description: A file sent with a message; its bytes at `/journal/{position}/attachments/{index}`.

ChatFileOut.title: ChatFileOut
ChatFileOut.description:
A file of a message, as the journal shows it, with the entry that serves it: its bytes at
`/journal/{position}/attachments/{index}`.

ChatStreamOut.title: ChatStreamOut
ChatStreamOut.description:
One line of an answer's stream: `text` words of the message being written, `end` that message complete
(`last`: no other follows), `failed` the answer broke off, `done` the stream is over.

Granularity.title: Granularity
Granularity.description: How much the presence source can tell, from coarse to fine (`at_least` compares).

Health.title: Health
Health.description: What a running component can tell about itself.

InstallKind.title: InstallKind
InstallKind.description: How this Nestor is installed, which says how it is updated.

JournalItem.title: JournalItem
JournalItem.description:
One journal entry: each sentence as a message (`id` + `args`, for a front with the catalogue) and
as text rendered by the server in the reader's language (so a plugin's events read well even when
the front has no message for them).

Kind.title: Kind
Kind.description: What the journal groups entries by: the facets of its filters, one per category, and `other`.

LinksOut.title: LinksOut
LinksOut.description: What threads entries together; the front builds threads and chains from these only.

MentionKind.title: MentionKind
MentionKind.description: What a message can name with `@`.

MentionOut.title: MentionOut
MentionOut.description: What a message can name with `@handle`: someone of the household, a room, an executor, a connected account.

MessageOut.title: MessageOut
MessageOut.description: A message as data: a front with its own Fluent catalogue renders `id` with `args` itself.

MethodOut.title: MethodOut
MethodOut.description: A pairing method, in the reader's language.

OriginOut.title: OriginOut
OriginOut.description: Where something was asked for: a task, a watch.

PairingMethod.title: PairingMethod
PairingMethod.description: How a person can pair this device; it declares those it supports, the person picks one.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: Why a phrase of an enrollment is asked again.

ProblemCode.title: ProblemCode
ProblemCode.description: What is wrong in a configuration; each names its message, `config-error-<code>`.

ProblemOut.title: ProblemOut
ProblemOut.description: What is wrong in an edited configuration, located by its path in the document.

Proof.title: Proof
Proof.description: Which way the pairing proof travelled.

ScheduledDeliveryOut.title: ScheduledDeliveryOut
ScheduledDeliveryOut.description: A written follow-up of something said aloud: sent at `due_at` unless someone answers first.

Scope.title: Scope
Scope.description: What an action needs. Code checks scopes, never roles: the role table is the only place they meet.

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: Where an addition stands, for the front's progress.

Suggest.title: Suggest
Suggest.description: What a map's keys or values may be picked from in a form (`suggest_keys`, `suggest_values` of a field).

UpdateOut.title: UpdateOut
UpdateOut.description: What a connected device last reported about its software.

UpdateState.title: UpdateState
UpdateState.description: Where a device's own software stands, as it reports it (`update.status`).

UpdatesOut.title: UpdatesOut
UpdatesOut.description: What was released since the running version, and how this Nestor gets it.
